evidence: Hor. Serm. 1.1.82: assideat, fōmenta paret, medicum roget, of Horace’s friend at the bedside

phrases.latin: fōmenta quoque calida sunt milium, sāl, harēna, quidlibet eōrum calfactum et in linteum conjectum
phrases.english: warm compresses are millet, salt, sand, any of them heated and put in a cloth

phrases.latin: Fōmentum calidum tibi in pectus impōnam.
phrases.english: I’ll put a warm compress on your chest.

sources: Lewis & Short: fomentum
John C. Traupman, Conversational Latin for Oral Proficiency has no entry for a compress.
